properties.originalText:
FLIGHT VALIDATION CHECK OF PAPI AND RNP APPROACH FOR RWY 28 WILL
TAKE PLACE.
WHILE SCHEDULING AND TACTICAL AIRSPACE MANAGEMENT DELAYS WILL BE
MINIMIZED, PILOTS ARE ADVISED THAT THE FLIGHT INSPECTION ACFT WILL
BE GIVEN BASIC PRIORITY OVER NORMAL TFC AND THUS THE 
COOPERATION OF ALL IS REQUIRED IN ORDER THAT THE INSPECTION OPS MAY
BE CONDUCTED AS SAFELY AND EFFICIENTLY AS POSSIBLE.
